curation.lead:
Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison LLP appears in the released records through a bounded set of lawyers and matters rather than one undifferentiated relationship [Finding #13233]. Five named firm personnel appear in direct exchanges with Jeffrey Epstein or his staff—Brad Karp, Alan Halperin, Brad Okun, Gregory Ezring and Brian Grieve—while Raphael Russo appears as a participant in a planned call; other personnel were copied, scheduled calls, or had work product forwarded by third parties [Finding #13120][Finding #13121][Finding #13119].

The clearest formal structure is a February 2013 agreement in which Leon Black retained Epstein and Southern Trust Company to assist Paul Weiss and McDermott Will & Emery with Black's estate planning [Finding #13160]. The agreement named Halperin and Kenneth Schneider as Paul Weiss notice contacts and restricted disclosure of privileged or confidential material unless authorized by Black or his law firms; it did not make Epstein a general Paul Weiss client or establish authorization for every later exchange [Finding #13160][Finding #13161].

Outside that mandate, the verified record includes completed Epstein-side work on a proposed Gates-related supporting organization, public firm representations, attempted counsel referrals, and unrelated later personnel appearances [Finding #13178][Finding #13195][Finding #13181][Finding #13225]. A four-record comparison documents distinct Paul Weiss contexts and personnel but does not itself establish a firmwide team or cross-matter information flow [Finding #13233].

sections.title: Correspondent and Personnel Ledger
sections.content:
The strict released-record roster contains five named Paul Weiss personnel in direct exchanges with Jeffrey Epstein or his staff: Brad Karp, Alan Halperin, Brad Okun, Gregory Ezring and Brian Grieve [Finding #13120]. Raphael Russo was identified for a planned call, so the record supports planned participation but does not establish that the call occurred [Finding #13120]. Brad Finkelstein and Mindy Lin appear in copied or planned-call roles, while Selinda Munzell, Linda Masson and an unidentified Karp assistant appear only in scheduling functions on the cited pages [Finding #13121].

Kenneth Schneider's Apollo consents and Yvonne Chan's Black investment documents reached Epstein through third-party forwards, not through located direct communications from those lawyers [Finding #13119]. Eric Goldstein, Jonathan Hurwitz and Jessica Carey appear in a separate filing as counsel adverse to Epstein-related claimants and therefore do not belong in the correspondent roster [Finding #13119]. These categories describe the reviewed release pages and do not establish that no additional public or nonpublic records exist [Finding #13119].

A later personnel recurrence is relevant but bounded: in October 2013, Boris Nikolic forwarded Epstein a JPMorgan packet containing biographies for Loretta Ippolito and two other New York trusts-and-estates lawyers [Finding #13231]. Paul Weiss had announced Ippolito as a partner in its personal-representation department three months earlier [Finding #13238], but the packet does not show that Nikolic or Epstein interviewed, retained, or communicated with her [Finding #13231]. A May 2021 court petition later named Ippolito and Bruce Birenboim as Paul Weiss counsel for Melinda French Gates; the corpus review found no personnel or information-flow bridge connecting the 2013 packet or Birenboim's unrelated 2016 Black-matter policy response to the divorce representation [Finding #13242][Finding #13225].

sections.title: The Black Mandate and Billing Denominator
sections.content:
On February 13, 2013, Leon Black formally retained Jeffrey Epstein and Southern Trust Company to assist Paul Weiss and McDermott Will & Emery in providing estate-planning advice to Black [Finding #13160]. The agreement's Paul Weiss notice contacts were Alan Halperin and Kenneth Schneider, not Brad Karp [Finding #13160]. It also prohibited Epstein and Southern Trust from disclosing privileged or confidential estate-planning information except as authorized by Black or the two law firms, creating a contractual boundary that must be tested message by message [Finding #13161].

The working record shows Epstein comments entering drafts for Leon and Debra Black's historical Forms 8865 reasonable-cause statements, with Karp, Brad Okun and Mindy Lin copied on part of the drafting chain [Finding #13153]. A contemporaneous message asked whether Paul Weiss was writing for all three Apollo founders, but the located materials establish drafting for Leon and Debra Black and do not answer that question affirmatively for Joshua Harris or Marc Rowan [Finding #13209]. Karp separately forwarded Epstein an update on Harris's gift-tax audit, but that page does not establish Harris's authorization, the representation boundary, or a privilege breach [Finding #13155].

A released Paul Weiss invoice summary for fiscal 2013 and 2014 itemizes $1,979,761.41 billed across existing estate planning, Project Art, Family Office work, family-member estate planning, a townhouse acquisition and a Sirius/XM derivative-suit balance [Finding #13204]. It records $706,603.94 paid and $1,273,157.47 due, but supplies no timekeeper allocations and does not identify any payment to Epstein [Finding #13204]. Separate Black-family projections label aggregate professional fees without naming a payee, so those figures cannot be assigned to Paul Weiss, Karp, Epstein, or another adviser from the cited pages [Finding #13144].

sections.title: Matter-Specific Work and Investigative Support
sections.content:
Within the Black matter, Paul Weiss lawyers performed identifiable technical work: Alan Halperin challenged an art/use-tax structure under Moline Properties, and other records identify separate lawyers on Phaidon tax, entity, licensing and document work [Finding #13147][Finding #13149]. Primary Family Office records also attribute aircraft and yacht-related advice to specialized counsel, including former Paul Weiss lawyer Richard Bronstein, rather than establishing a Brad Karp role in those technical workstreams [Finding #13208].

Four Nardello memoranda delivered to Karp and Lorin Reisner state that their respective recordings were made with JD's consent; a separate October 19 draft-transcript delivery contains no equivalent consent statement [Finding #13218]. The located documents do not identify the engagement signatory or payer [Finding #13218]. The recording particulars support a bounded identity match to Leon Black's later-pleaded dispute with Guzel Ganieva, while leaving the contracting client, payment source and authorization unresolved [Finding #13219]. The broader record therefore supports episodic, client-centered assistance with pockets of two-way professional exchange, not a demonstrated durable system spanning every firm matter [Finding #13213].

sections.title: Client and Matter Boundaries
sections.content:
In 2014, Paul Weiss lawyers Raphael Russo and Gregory Ezring completed substantive review of a supporting-organization roadmap for Jeffrey Epstein, while the Gates Foundation general counsel stated that Morgan Lewis remained Foundation counsel [Finding #13178]. The record supports Epstein-side Paul Weiss work and consultation with Foundation counsel, but no located engagement letter, invoice or payer record shows that the Foundation retained or paid Paul Weiss [Finding #13178].

The located records document other matters with different postures. Paul Weiss publicly states that Brad Karp led the team advising Carlos Ghosn in a 2019 SEC settlement, but no source traces information offered by Epstein into that settlement [Finding #13195]. An archived firm biography listed SoftBank among Karp's clients without identifying the matter, dates, scope, payer, or Rajeev Misra as the client [Finding #13162]. A Caesars exchange proves a terse Karp-Epstein discussion and separate firm work, but not Karp's personal mandate or the content source for his answer [Finding #13106].

In the Robert Kraft sequence, Epstein offered Karp a local Palm Beach representative and Karp replied only that Kraft needed “the best”; later counsel-related activity is separately documented, but the cited records do not prove that Karp accepted the offer, caused the engagement, or that Paul Weiss represented Kraft [Finding #13181]. The Melinda French Gates petition, Black assistance agreement, and Ghosn settlement document formal firm matters with different personnel and postures [Finding #13225][Finding #13160][Finding #13195]. The archived SoftBank biography establishes only a client-list relationship and leaves the matter, dates, scope and payer unidentified; the Caesars records establish firm work and a separate Karp-Epstein exchange without proving Karp's personal mandate [Finding #13162][Finding #13106]. The reviewed record leaves Kraft as an attempted-referral and later counsel-contact context rather than a proved Paul Weiss engagement [Finding #13181].

sections.title: Firm Governance and Karp's Succession
sections.content:
Paul Weiss's first-party biography identifies Brad Karp as firm chair from 2008 through 2026 and as a lifelong firm lawyer who previously chaired the Litigation Department [Finding #13077]. In March 2025, Executive Order 14237 imposed restrictions on the firm; after a meeting with Karp and announced firm commitments, Executive Order 14244 revoked the earlier order [Finding #13082]. A later federal decision discussing the comparable Perkins Coie order characterized the Paul Weiss sequence as evidence of governmental coercive power, but it did not adjudicate the Paul Weiss order or agreement [Finding #13175].

On February 4, 2026, the firm announced that Scott Barshay had become chair after Karp decided to resign, while Karp would continue full-time client service [Finding #13084]. Paul Weiss's current profile continues to identify Karp as a New York partner and records post-chair professional activity [Finding #13183].

curation.system_role: Paul Weiss functioned as outside counsel, technical adviser and litigation counsel across several elite-client matters, with a documented but matter-specific set of contacts involving Jeffrey Epstein. The released record supports formal assistance in Leon Black's estate-planning workflow and several narrower overlaps, while leaving payer, tasking, authorization and privilege questions unresolved in other contexts [Finding #13160][Finding #13233].
open_questions: Which engagement letters, invoices and time records identify the client, payer and authorized scope for each Epstein-adjacent Paul Weiss workstream?
Did the planned Russo call occur, and are there additional direct communications that would change the strict correspondent roster?
Who retained and paid Nardello for the 2015 recording and surveillance work delivered to Karp and Reisner?
Did Nikolic or Epstein take any action after receiving Ippolito's 2013 biography, and is there any documented contact with her?
What authorizations governed transmission of Harris-related and other third-party client information to Epstein?

citation_findings.detail: The firm's first-party biography resolves the subject's professional identity and tenure. It lists Karp as a current partner in New York at 1285 Avenue of the Americas and states that he spent his entire career at the firm, beginning as a summer associate.

citation_findings.summary: After Executive Order 14237 imposed clearance, contracting, access, and hiring restrictions on Paul, Weiss, a March 20, 2025 presidential post said Trump met firm chair Brad Karp and announced firm commitments including political-neutrality policies, a DEI audit, and $40 million in pro bono services. Executive Order 14244 revoked the prior order on March 21 and recited those commitments.
citation_findings.detail: The March 20 post contains a White House characterization of what Karp acknowledged and a separate, narrower quote from Karp welcoming withdrawal of the order. The finding records what the government and Karp publicly said; it does not independently validate the government’s allegations or determine the agreement’s legality.

citation_findings.summary: New surveillance, billing, specialist-counsel, and Ghosn evidence strengthens a narrow matter-specific reciprocity conclusion without establishing a durable systematic symbiosis. Karp relayed concrete surveillance status and movement information to Epstein, while Epstein comments entered Black tax drafting and Epstein offered Ghosn information; however the located Paul Weiss billing lacks timekeeper allocation, specialist counsel handled other technical work, and no source traces Epstein information into the later Ghosn settlement. The best-supported model remains episodic client-centered contact with pockets of two-way professional assistance.
citation_findings.detail: This synthesis treats the Black surveillance, Nardello, Forms 8865, fee, and billing records as one client-centered evidence cluster rather than separate votes. The Ghosn information offer, Pritzker timing, Tokyo reply, and SEC outcome are likewise one sequence. It does not infer the surveillance client, payer, investigator, authorization, or outcome; it does not claim that Epstein information was nonpublic or used; and it does not claim that no unlocated compensation or engagement record exists.

citation_findings.summary: SYSTEMIC PATTERN: The May 3, 2021 Gates divorce petition names Bruce Birenboim and Loretta Ippolito of Paul, Weiss for Melinda French Gates; the two lawyers' located Epstein-release occurrences are unrelated, role-consistent 2013 and 2016 matters, and no common-personnel or information-flow bridge to the divorce was found.
citation_findings.detail: Page 4 of King County Superior Court case 21-3-02273-1 SEA lists Birenboim and Ippolito as attorneys for petitioner; Brad Karp is not named. The exact-name search across all six configured corpora returned five Kabass hits that deduplicated to two events, two LMSBAND duplicates, and zero Unified email/document, House 20K, FBI, or reporting results. In October 2013, JPMorgan sent Boris Nikolic biographies for Ippolito and two other New York trusts-and-estates lawyers as possible interview candidates; Nikolic forwarded the package to Epstein, but the page does not mention Bill Gates, Melinda Gates, divorce, a hiring, or any communication with Ippolito. In March 2016, Birenboim stated an internal Paul Weiss escrow policy in a Leon Black matter; Karp later forwarded the response to Epstein. The negative result is scoped to configured corpora and does not prove that private or undisclosed contacts never occurred.
citation_findings.target_name: Melinda French Gates / Paul, Weiss representation

citation_findings.detail: The attached records show: Leon Black engaged Southern Trust Company to assist his advisers at Paul Weiss and McDermott; Morgan Lewis scheduled a Gates Foundation-related call with Paul Weiss contacts; the 2021 Gates divorce petition names Bruce Birenboim and Loretta Ippolito for Melinda French Gates; and a Paul Weiss release described a firm of more than 1,000 lawyers.
